visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width promotional sale banner with an offer heading, a list of category CTA pills, an optional live countdown and a legal line
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width promo banner, solid #f0f0eb background when no image; content left-middle; big bold price-tag style heading; white pill buttons with dark text stacked/inline; countdown timer text; small legal text #222.

contentPattern.name: promo banner with CTA list
contentPattern.structure: optional background image (desktop picture, then optional mobile crop); offer heading; one paragraph per category CTA link; optional end date paragraph in MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss AM/PM format (rendered as a live countdown and hidden after expiry); legal text paragraph
contentPattern.blockContent: Row 1: optional background image (desktop, then mobile crop). Row 2: offer heading (h2, e.g. "PRE-EID DEALS | 40% OFF"), stacked category CTA links (Women, Men, Kids, Home, Beauty), optional countdown end date (paragraph, e.g. "03/21/2026 10:00:00 AM"), small legal line.

usage: Use for time-limited sale/offer banners that link to several departments.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any promo strip with a heading plus multiple CTA links; use hero-content-bottom for single-CTA image campaigns.
